terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By using Vesto to manage your wardrobe, you agree to the following conditions:
terms.point_1: Storage: Your photos and data are securely stored in Supabase.
terms.point_2: Privacy: Vesto does not share or sell your information to third parties.
terms.point_3: Usage: The app is for personal garment and outfit management.
terms.point_4: Responsibility: You are responsible for the security of your access credentials.

copyright.title: Copyright Policy
copyright.intro: Vesto respects the intellectual property rights of others:
copyright.point_1: Ownership: You are the legal owner of the garment photos you upload to your closet.
copyright.point_2: License: By uploading content, you grant Vesto permission to store and display it on your account.
copyright.point_3: Restrictions: You are not allowed to upload images for which you do not own the rights.
copyright.point_4: Reports: If you believe your work has been copied, please contact us via support.

hero.title: Dress better in seconds
hero.description: Organize your wardrobe and create personalized outfits without wasting time every morning.

howItWorks.title: How does Vesto work?
howItWorks.description: Upload your wardrobe items with a photo, combine them to create personalized outfits, and document your looks by uploading selfies with each outfit. All in one place, simple and intuitive.

reviews.title: Valued by our community
reviews.angel: Vesto has completely transformed my morning routine. Having all my clothes organized digitally saves me time and helps me discover combinations I never would have imagined. An essential app!
reviews.jesus: I had been looking for a way to get more out of my wardrobe for a long time, and Vesto has delivered. The personalized outfit creation feature is incredible; I can finally plan my looks in advance. 100% recommended!
reviews.paco: The interface is very intuitive and uploading items is straightforward. Within a few days I had my entire wardrobe digitized and started discovering combinations I never would have worn. A fantastic tool.
reviews.elias: I hadn't seen such a complete and functional app. Vesto has revolutionized how I choose my clothes! I love the feature to create custom outfits, it's like having a personal stylist in your pocket. Highly recommended!
